transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I keep starting the sanitation steps, batch logs, or the end-of-line paperwork, and then somehow I leave out the last parts. Even when I know I need to finish them correctly for my job, I just don’t follow all the way through.
How long have you been having this trouble finishing tasks?
It’s been a serious problem since I started working full-time in meat processing, about two years and four months ago.
Did you struggle with finishing schoolwork or chores like this when you were a child?

Yes. My mom still has report cards from around fourth grade that said I was bright, but I needed constant reminders to finish my classwork and turn in homework. I understood the lessons, but I’d miss parts of the instructions unless the teacher stayed pretty close to me.
Aside from the trouble completing tasks, have you been feeling persistently down or depressed?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed feeling down all the time, no.
Do you often find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things, even when there is no clear reason to?
I don’t think so. I mean, I worry about things sometimes, but not constantly or about a bunch of different things for no reason.
